scope: read-only frozen historical offsets and a default-off pure diagnostic gate; no simulation or gameplay changes

read_only_queries.decision-index.json: SELECT run_id,off,len,ts,floor,turn,label,latency_plan_ms,latency_jev_ms,latency_action_ms,rollout_ms FROM decisions WHERE run_id IN ('CVJ4MLQF4CSY','N9GKED3PMEV3') AND floor=48 ORDER BY ts
read_only_queries.noncombat-index.json: SELECT run_id,off,len,ts,floor,label FROM decisions WHERE run_id IN ('CVJ4MLQF4CSY','N9GKED3PMEV3') AND floor<>48 AND label NOT LIKE 'combat/%' ORDER BY ts
